name: slider
useFor: Use Slider to pick a number from a range where the exact value matters less than its place (concurrent sandboxes, memory). Show the value as text beside its label. Pass two values for a range. For an exact number use Input with type="number".
constraints: A thumb that grows on hover or drag
source: Extrapolated from the Hoplite website: its strong line (--line), ink (--charcoal on the light ground) and hexagonal marks (.pr-features svg)
title: Slider
description: A 1px track of the strong line with the chosen range drawn as a 2px ink line and a 16px point-up ink hexagon as the thumb; it follows the pointer and never changes shape while dragged.
